desc: The Ruger LCP MAX holds over 10+1 rounds in the same space as the LCP II. It is smaller than any other micro-9 pistol on the market, broadening options for comfortable and easy concealed carry. The LCP MAX's double-stack magazine feed lips are optimized to reliably feed a wide range of modern .380 Auto ammunition. It features a tritium front sight with a white outline, and rear drift-adjustable sights to make accurate shooting easier. The medium-textured grip frame ensures easy access to the Secure Action trigger. Celebrate America's 250th Anniversary with this special commemorative model.
